text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae), positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, elevated leukocytes, and presence of blood, indicating a urinary tract infection. Glucosuria is noted, which may warrant further evaluation for hyperglycemia or diabetes. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
